name: Sturdy
description: The Pokemon is not knocked out from full HP by a one-hit KO move or a move that would leave it with 0 HP.

name: Flash Fire
description: Powers up the Pokemon's Fire-type moves if it's hit by one.

name: Intimidate
description: Lowers the opposing Pokemon's Attack stat when entering battle.

name: Inner Focus
description: The Pokemon is protected from flinching.

name: Sand Stream
description: The Pokemon summons a sandstorm that lasts 5 turns when it enters battle.

name: Cute Charm
description: Contact with the Pokemon may cause infatuation.

name: Shed Skin
description: The Pokemon may heal its own status conditions by shedding its skin.

name: Rock Head
description: Protects the Pokemon from recoil damage.

name: Multiscale
description: Reduces damage the Pokemon takes when its HP is full.

name: Justified
description: Being hit by a Dark-type move boosts the Attack stat of the Pokemon, for justice.

name: Pixilate
description: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type and deal 20% more damage.

name: Sand Spit
description: The Pokemon creates a sandstorm when it's hit by an attack.

name: Sand Veil
description: Boosts the Pokemon's evasiveness in a sandstorm.

name: Berserk
description: Boosts Sp. Atk by 1 when HP drops to half or below.
